title: Beatrix and the Verdict
author: V. M. Sandoval
blurb: August Voss, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
